summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for LM27313XMF/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5, boost): evaluated 25 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 8 ranked replacements (0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 3 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 5 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Confirm topology (boost, external Schottky diode), pinout, and exposed thermal pad (None) on SOT-23-5.
Re-verify switching frequency (1600 kHz), inductor value (10 µH), and inductor Isat margin (>= 25% above peak switch current).
Check feedback reference Vref (1.23 V) and recalculate R1/R2 divider plus feedforward cap before power-up.
Audit hot-loop ceramic input/output capacitance placement and thermal dissipation at worst-case Vin and ambient temperature.
